gated.why: counted in `total` and in every colour they can make, but their coloured mode costs extra mana on top of the tap, so they cannot pay a coloured cost on curve

assumptions: Colour probabilities are hypergeometric draws from a 60-card library — no mulligans, no card selection, no fetching decisions.
A source counts only for mana it produces unconditionally; restricted mana (“spend this mana only…”) counts for nothing (the deck-builder's rule).
Hybrid pips charge half a pip to each side.
Rocks and dorks are counted as sources from the turn they can tap, with no survival discount on creatures.
notes: G: 16 land sources against the 22 a 90% on-curve rate would take — the target is a yardstick, not a possibility, in a 16-land deck; rocks and dorks lift the count to 24.
the goldfish is Commander-only; not run for Modern
